$comment: Evaluation sets of scripts/eval.py (Linear DEV-147). dev: rules may be tuned against these projects. held-out: never tuned against; labels, configuration and revision are frozen in FROZEN.json. A held-out project that drives a fix moves to dev (record it in `history`) and a new held-out project is added from `reserve`. Every project is Drizzle + PostgreSQL (the supported ORM); the first proposed held-out candidates (cal.com, dub, documenso, formbricks) use Prisma and were not eligible. Checkouts live under .corpora/ (git-ignored) and are never executed or modified.

projects.name: midday
projects.notes: The project the rules were developed against (Phases 2-16). Labels: Phase 2 review of a sample of findings (corpora/labels/midday.json); no audited known positives, so recall is not computed for it.

projects.name: kan
projects.notes: Kanban app: tRPC routers over repository functions, email, webhooks, Stripe, S3.

projects.name: dittofeed
projects.notes: Customer messaging: Postgres through db(), Temporal workflows, ClickHouse, Kafka, message providers.

projects.name: zero
projects.notes: Email client on Cloudflare Workers: Drizzle, a database Durable Object, Gmail/Outlook APIs, queues, R2/KV. Moved from held-out to dev on 2026-11-06: its false positives (the generic `fetch` rule) are to be fixed, which is tuning against it.

projects.name: vercel-chatbot
projects.notes: Next.js AI chat template: Drizzle + postgres-js queries in lib/db/queries.ts, Vercel Blob uploads, Redis resumable streams and rate limiting. Promoted from reserve on 2026-11-06.

history.change: Sets created. Held-out configurations were written from the projects' source by agents that did not run the analyzer, before any held-out finding was looked at. Before that, one run with the default configuration only checked that the analyzer reaches each project's database code; its finding counts were seen, not the findings.

zero moved from held-out to dev: all 10 of its false positives in the first scoring come from the generic `fetch` configuration rule, and fixing that is tuning against it. Its frozen entry (revision 36132735, config 68ff38d2..., labels 2076f2b4...) was removed from FROZEN.json. vercel-chatbot promoted from reserve to held-out at a8989b52 (HEAD of main on 2026-11-06): configuration written from source before the analyzer was run on it, known positives from a source-only audit, findings classified by a separate agent. The reserve is now empty.
